fieldNotes.location: Roster coords landed in a dense Hayward industrial park; address 30977 San Clemente St geocoded (OSM) to 37.6133,-122.0526. Note: Hormel/Columbus has TWO Hayward plants - the San Antonio St plant was announced for closure (March 2025), the San Clemente St plant remains. This audit is the San Clemente St facility. Locked center 37.6133,-122.0526.
fieldNotes.truckGate: No perimeter fence, barrier arm, or gate. The building's dock face fronts directly on San Clemente St with open parking-lot access on all sides - fully uncontrolled.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth observed anywhere on the property in Street View (2025-10) or satellite.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False - no gate, so no remote check-in.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dock doors recessed along the east face fronting San Clemente St; ~10-15 doors visible with a few trailers/vans backed in. 10-25 band. A couple of additional dock positions at the SE corner.
fieldNotes.dropArea: No trailer drop yard - the lots around the building are marked car-parking stalls (employee parking), no parked trailers without tractors observed. dropArea NONE.
fieldNotes.drivewayShort: Docks open onto a narrow apron directly off San Clemente St; only 1-2 trucks fit in the approach.
fieldNotes.railServed: A single through-track runs along the west side between buildings but does not spur into the plant - no rail dock. railServed false.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Dense Hayward (San Francisco Bay Area metro) industrial-park fabric - Urban.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock activity concentrated on a single east-face bank - combined ship/receive.

citations.claim: Hormel's Columbus Craft Meats plant in Hayward on San Antonio St (30977 San Antonio St) closing March 2026 per WARN (~125 affected); a second Hayward plant remains.
Listing for 30977 San Antonio St, Hayward (the audited house number) shows COLUMBUS DISTRIBUTING - CLOSED.

verification.rationale: Audited coord 37.6133,-122.0526 / house number 30977 resolves to 30977 San Antonio St (every authoritative source places Columbus Mfg there) = the plant announced for closure March 2026; the San Clemente St label was a bad geocode. The surviving second Hayward plant is a different, unidentified address. Closure -> reject.
